name: stac-va-t8
purpose: STAC ladder with player trading (chat negotiation): planner_pv2_tiles as one seat vs 3 POMCP-TS-CR (256 games) and vs 3 STAC negotiators (512 games), seeded so both policies (experiments/stac-ladder-{served,tiles}.json) face the same boards, decks, first players, seats and dice. Analysis experiments/stac-ladder.json.

pomcp_ts_cr.source: Dobre & Lascarides, POMCP with Human Preferences in Settlers of Catan (AIIDE 2018), POMCP-TS-CR; paper setting 10k iterations, 4 threads, C=4 with PUCT, offers limit 3

stac_negotiator.source: STAC's JSettlers-derived negotiating agent (soc.robot.stac.StacRobotBrain via StacRobotFactory, default StacRobotType): negotiates trades in STAC's chat format

limitations: STAC's MCTS agents are not reproducible even when seeded, so pairing removes environment luck (board, deck, first player, seats, dice by roll index, steals, discards) but not opponent-play variance. Seats come from STAC's seeded shuffle, not a rotation (position counts are recorded and identical across the pair). The 10 s per-search cap deviates from the paper's uncapped 10k iterations; cap hits and >1 s overruns are counted. Our bot never counter-offers. Both policies run concurrently on the same host (ultra) so MCTS time budgets are comparable.
note: value-arms held-out, reported external number (no gate): planner_pv2_tiles_va_t8 on the stac-ladder-tiles seeds and STAC build, so scripts/stac_paired.py pairs it with the existing planner_pv2_tiles ladder receipt (runs/stac-ladder-v1/tiles on ultra). Predeclared 2026-11-11 before any game.
